harness_repair.diagnosis: Reproduction of the previously documented docs/design/autotrain-cycle-c2-agentv-missing-infra-failure.json (fixed by commits 1faeff44/8da7b777 on 2026-08-03) in a fresh ephemeral remote-execution container. Neither scripts/setup_dev_env.sh nor its equivalent had been run yet for this container's checkout: no .venv, no torch, no repo-root node_modules (no @agentv/core), and no node_modules under src/apps/openui_bridge or src/apps/design_md_bridge. evaluate_model.py --ship-gates crashed in publish_model_evaluation before producing a scoreboard for both arms, identical to the prior finding.
harness_repair.fix_summary: No code change required — the fix already lives in scripts/setup_dev_env.sh from the prior repair (#1360). Ran the equivalent bootstrap for this session: `python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"` (pulls the pinned CPU torch wheel via the dev extra), `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci` at the repo root (installs @agentv/core), and `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci` in src/apps/openui_bridge and src/apps/design_md_bridge. Verified node_modules/@agentv/core/package.json exists afterward. This is an expected one-time bootstrap cost on every fresh ephemeral container, not a regression.
